lines.text: Many learners say: I work at a fabric.
Better: I work at a factory.
Factory! He works in a factory.

native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “I work at a fabric.”? 😅 “Fabric” похоже на «фабрика», но это ткань. Фабрика — “factory”. Правильно: “I work at a factory.”. Послушай Карлос и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “factory”. Фабрика — factory, ткань — fabric. Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: “Fabric” means cloth. A plant is a “factory”.
en.caption: Do you also say “I work at a fabric.”? 😅 “Fabric” looks like “fabrika”, but it means cloth. A plant is “factory”. Correct: “I work at a factory.”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
